name: tamga
tagline: Scan LLM prompts and responses for PII and prompt injection
description: tamga is a proxy that scans prompts and LLM responses for PII, secrets, and prompt injection before they reach the model. It uses an Aho-Corasick DFA to classify payloads in sub-millisecond time, and its rules map to compliance regimes like KVKK, GDPR, and PCI-DSS. Running as an inline proxy keeps the scan transparent to both the application and the model, making it a drop-in guardrail for LLM-powered products.
highlights: Scans both prompts and model responses in real time
Aho-Corasick DFA engine with sub-millisecond classification
Detects PII, secrets, and prompt injection attempts
Rules aligned with KVKK, GDPR, and PCI-DSS
Transparent inline proxy — no app or model changes
curatorNote: Every serious LLM deployment needs a guardrail between the app and the model, and tamga's proxy approach with sub-ms classification is the pragmatic version — no agent changes, just a transparent scan for PII, secrets, and injection.
